pages.title: Recipe Index
pages.text: Recipe cards for this equipment role. Return to $(l:aura:accessory_loadout)Accessory Loadout$(/l).

pages.title: Protection Colors
pages.text: While worn: Red blocks fire, Orange explosions, Green falls, and Blue drowning; those blocked hits heal except direct flame. Yellow halves projectile damage without healing. Violet blocks Wither damage but does not heal.

pages.title: Activate the Wing
pages.text: Equip the Wing in the Amulet slot and press Activate Wing (V by default). Look level or upward to ascend; look steeply down to descend to a clear standing place. Change the key in Controls.

pages.title: Forbidden Fruit
pages.text: Finish eating or drinking with it equipped: each food or drink grants the same gift on every use. Apples bring regeneration; potions and milk also qualify. The gift follows completed use, even in Creative mode. Canceling a meal or drink grants nothing.
